sloka: खड्गा धनूंषि ज्याबाणास्तोमराङ्कुशशक्तयः।रोमजं वालजं चर्म व्याघ्रजं चाण्डजं बहु ।। ६.७५.११ ।।
transliteration: khaḍgā dhanūṁṣi jyābāṇāstomarāṅkuśaśaktayaḥ।romajaṁ vālajaṁ carma vyāghrajaṁ cāṇḍajaṁ bahu ।। 6.75.11 ।।

translations.english: Leather armour of the warriors, shields of horses, excellent bow strings, swords, arrows, goads, lances, and javelins.
